Exercise: Bottoms Up

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- hip_flexion
- spinal_flexion
- extension

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC system

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- core_strengthening
- abdominal_muscle_engagement

Contraindications:

- Lower back pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Bottoms Up with Resistance Band, equipment: resistance band

Substitution Options:

- name: Plank, force: static hold, level: beginner

Instructions:

- Begin by lying on your back on the ground. Your legs should be straight and your arms at your side. This will be your starting position.
- To perform the movement, tuck the knees toward your chest by flexing the hips and knees. Following this, extend your legs directly above you so that they are perpendicular to the ground. Rotate and elevate your pelvis to raise your glutes from the floor.
- After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
